claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the current record, with the strongest supportable basis being certification only if the remaining enterprise refund-workflow limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card rather than asserting no known material limitations.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current weakness in a named launch use case: the enterprise refund workflow remains below target, concentrated in refund-policy summarization.
The draft mitigation runbook is incomplete because required governance fields remain TBD, including rollback threshold and review date.
The current model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice issue and reviewer concern.
Under the stated policy, a current material limitation must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The packet's structured recommendation is 'certify_model', which overstates the support unless that certification is explicitly conditioned on disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
unsupported_claims: Any caveat-free certification position is unsupported on this record.
Any implication that future monitoring or a draft runbook removes the present disclosure requirement is unsupported.
Any implication that there are no known material limitations is contradicted by the admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the final approved model-card text showing disclosure of the enterprise refund-workflow limitation.
Provide an approved risk-acceptance record if the limitation will not be disclosed before launch.
Provide a completed and approved mitigation runbook with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide updated evaluation evidence showing the refund-workflow slice has been remediated to target if claiming the limitation is no longer material.
decision_criteria: Certification without material caveats requires evidence that no material weakness remains, or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness, but do not by themselves negate a remaining material limitation in a named use case.
Public model-card and AI-risk guidance can support documentation and monitoring expectations, but they do not substitute for the policy predicates above.
